import sqlite3

db_path = '/home/user/legacy.db'
output_path = '/home/user/graph_import.cypher'

conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

cur.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gamma_refs ON t_gamma(a_ref1, a_ref2)")
conn.commit()

# Execute query
query = """
SELECT g.a_ref1, g.a_ref2 
FROM t_gamma g 
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT a_ref FROM t_beta WHERE publish_date > '2022-01-01') b1 ON g.a_ref1 = b1.a_ref 
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT a_ref FROM t_beta WHERE publish_date > '2022-01-01') b2 ON g.a_ref2 = b2.a_ref 
ORDER BY g.a_ref1 ASC, g.a_ref2 ASC;
"""

cur.execute(query)
rows = cur.fetchall()

with open(output_path, 'w') as f:
    for row in rows:
        f.write(f"CREATE (u1:User {{id: {row[0]}}})-[:CONNECTED_ACTIVE]->(u2:User {{id: {row[1]}}})\n")

conn.close()
EOF
